title.narrative: Enhancing Sustainable Agroforestry for Resilience in Quang Ngai, Vietnam (ESAR) Project

description.narrative:
Quang Ngai Province is severely impacted by climate change, experiencing frequent extreme weather events such as typhoons, floods, droughts, and landslides. Traditional farming practices, especially slash-and-burn agriculture, have exacerbated these issues, leading to substantial deforestation, soil erosion, and land degradation. From 2002 to 2023, Quang Ngai lost 27.1 thousand hectares of humid primary forest, accounting for 17% of its total tree cover loss, with ethnic minority communities being the most affected due to their reliance on low-productivity agriculture and forestry activities. The primary problems in Quang Ngai include significant deforestation and environmental degradation, low agricultural productivity, and high vulnerability to climate change for remote ethnic minority communities. Addressing these issues necessitates the adoption of sustainable agroforestry practices, capacity building for local government and community partners, and effective community engagement. As the local government and communities are not equipped with adequate sustainable agroforestry knowledge, there is an urgent need to strengthen their capacity to promote sustainable development and increase resilience to climate change. Effective community engagement through the establishment of communication platforms is essential for facilitating knowledge exchange and supporting sustainable practices.
World Vision International in Vietnam (WVI-Vietnam) proposes the Enhancing Sustainable Agroforestry for Resilience in Quang Ngai, Vietnam (ESAR) project as a strategic intervention to promote sustainable agroforestry and enhance climate resilience through applying World Vision’s Regreening model. Specifically, the project will implement training programs on sustainable agroforestry for local government partners, mass organizations, and farmers. The objective of the project is to enhance the capacity of local government, mass organization partners and farmers from selected communities in Quang Ngai Province, Vietnam on sustainable agroforestry practices.
